events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Theme Tune Battle
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 by asking: which Bond theme tune gets your vote as the absolute best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, and would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, his genius has given us endless laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that broke all the rules. What's your go-to track from this epic double LP?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: November 24, 2026, marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, showcasing a significant artistic evolution for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' – an album that changed everything in 1965. Which track still gives you chills?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's death
events.blurb: December 8, 2026, marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on from his passing. His music and message of peace resonate as strongly today as ever. What's the John Lennon song that means most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Visionary artist David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible legacy of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true innovator whose influence is still felt everywhere. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, born on January 8, 1935, would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Elvis Presley. The King lives on! What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! A true guitar innovator who shaped the sound of rock. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer with a distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rockin' Rod's 82nd
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! Still rockin' after all these years. What's your go-to Rod Stewart singalong?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's 66th
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! The voice behind so many brilliant tunes. What's your favourite Madness track to get you skanking?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the wonderful Paul Young! Still got that incredible voice. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend and global icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly!
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true queen of music, kindness, and wit. What's your favourite Dolly song or quote?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's 56th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend. What's your favourite Gary Barlow or Take That hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars with your favourite track. Which one is it?
